function factorize($n) {
    $factors = [];

            while ($n % $d == 0) {
                $cnt++;
                $n /= $d;
            }
            $factors[] = [$d, $cnt];
        }
        $d++;
    }
    if ($n > 1) {
        $factors[] = [$n, 1];
    }
    return $factors;
}
